up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are mentioned in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1123873. For each such molecule, return its ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id), the compound name as recorded in that document (compound_name), and its canonical SMILES string (canonical_smiles). Only include molecules for which a canonical SMILES is available. Order the results ascending by chembl_id, then by compound_name, then by canonical_smiles.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123873' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
